canonical_identity.rule: UI must display source_id as Phat integer, document_db_id as documents.id, and ingestion_run_id as Duy run UUID.

metadata.snapshot_note: The database view snapshot uses Phat's loaded run UUIDs; Duy's newest run UUIDs are intentionally kept in the Duy fixture until reloaded.

screenshots_audit.note: File presence is verified; screenshot freshness must be confirmed against refreshed fixtures.

blocking_findings.finding: Phi/Hung tests or UI smoke test failed
blocking_findings.fix: Install the pinned UI requirements and rerun both commands.

cleanup_candidates.action: Archive after confirming all active tests use demo/fixtures/week7/.

cleanup_candidates.reason: Historical task document is large and contains superseded mock paths and contracts.
cleanup_candidates.action: Move to docs/archive/ or clearly mark as historical.

cleanup_candidates.reason: These folders are not part of the active Streamlit Week 7 runtime boundary.
cleanup_candidates.action: Keep only if owned deliverables still depend on them; otherwise archive outside the shared UI module.

cleanup_candidates.reason: Historical screenshots can be mistaken for the Week 7 staging demo.
cleanup_candidates.action: Archive and keep screenshots/week7_staging_ready_ui/ as the active demo evidence.

required_phi_hung_actions: Replace Tuong batch and review-queue fixtures with DB-enriched outputs that preserve non-null source_id, document_db_id, and ingestion_run_id.
Install the pinned Phi/Hung requirements and rerun both the full test suite and UI smoke test.
notes: Duy, Phat, Lap, and Tuong fixture results are calculated from the current sibling-repository snapshots.
Code, documentation, and screenshot checks are reported separately from fixture lineage and executable tests.
The audit is read-only against the sibling Phi/Hung repository; owner fixes require a Phi/Hung commit.
